name: @singularity/plugin-apps-deploy-analytics-host-only
description: Routes reachable only from the deployed box itself: the /api/host-only/ prefix Caddy refuses publicly, the hostOnly(handler) second guard (404 unless the request made exactly one proxy hop), and requestClientIp(req) — the one place that knows the Caddy → gateway → backend X-Forwarded-For chain.
